name: Itori
source:
Itori is an old friend of [url=/c73118]Yomo[/url] and [url=/c73123]Uta[/url]. She can be found in Helter Skelter bar, where she shares information in the underworld. Itori is also a member of the Clowns. 

[From [url=http://tokyoghoul.wikia.com/wiki/Itori]Tokyo Ghoul Wikia[/url]]
